features.feature: Preserve a current code-review receipt across registered nonmaterial closeout metadata writes when materialHash, storyFilesHash, scope, policy, command set, and review round are unchanged.
Keep review-retention classification separate from closeout-artifact admissibility; retention never authorizes an artifact.
Independently validate each closeout artifact's structure, signature, writer provenance, and freshness at its consuming gate.
Fail closed for source/story-owned/config/policy/command-set/scope/round drift, unknown writer/path, manual tamper, malformed or unsigned lineage, and HEAD races.
Register any new gate-consumed closeout/review semantic in the process-fact registry and contract verifier.
Align delivery reviewer dispatch phase with delivery_check_set mutation phase and enforce one legal cardinality/order.
Converge REVIEW→TEST→DONE with zero metadata-only rollback, extra review re-attestation, human acknowledgement, or unchanged-suite execution.
Reuse only a fully identity-matched fresh routine/DONE-required PASS; validate:false remains distinct and true failures remain failures.
Use deterministic closeout telemetry/counters to prove one successful closeout and no nested duplicate validation.
Classify declaration-preserving function/method body edits as modification rather than deleted symbol.
Preserve true declaration deletion, rename/signature/export drift, overload/scope identity, parser-failure, and residual-reference blockers.
Restrict DEV verification to focused lifecycle, closeout-trust, review-run, delivery-dispatch, concept-gate, and process-fact contract checks.
Treat the full configured validation suite as TEST/DONE-only and reuse a fresh identity-matched PASS.
No real hosts, network, global lattice, root full suite during DEV, destructive git, remote publish, or user-owned main artifacts.
No weakening of review quorum/assurance, no automatic reviewer/host/delivery/Authority signatures, and no production-DONE claim.
features.excluded_by: CHK-001 separation boundary; generated-metadata auto-closeout non-goals

features.feature: No Authority Server receipt implementation; lifecycle receipt doc supplies only the independent gate-consumption principle.
No full requirements-corpus scan; deterministic candidates and explicit related docs are sufficient for this narrow remediation.
